purpose: Test whether official TAIEX + official TWSE-only breadth + macro/valuation regime adds stable OOS information beyond seasonality and momentum. Research/SHADOW only.

breadth_features.source: TWSE official MI_INDEX stock column from 漲跌證券數合計

macro_features.coverage_gate: each feature >=80% of eligible snapshots; otherwise macro block excluded as a whole and result labeled v0.2-market-only

valuation_features.coverage_gate: both features >=80% of eligible snapshots; otherwise valuation block excluded as a whole and result labeled v0.2-market-only

distance.method: equal-weight block Euclidean after within-snapshot z-standardization
distance.missing_block_rule: do not impute from future data; entire optional block excluded if coverage gate fails

promotion_gate.direction_edge_requirement: positive vs both seasonality and momentum
promotion_gate.bootstrap_requirement: 95% CI lower bound > 0 for at least one horizon AND no material degradation on the other horizon
promotion_gate.brier_requirement: not worse than seasonality on promoted horizon
promotion_gate.mae_requirement: not materially worse than zero-return baseline
promotion_gate.decision_if_fail: formal_weight remains 0; preserve result; do not tune this frozen specification

notes: v0.1 result was NOT PROVEN and is preserved unchanged.
2009 is not privileged; all eligible prior years compete equally.
No black-swan categorical hindsight labels are used as model features.
Company fundamentals and portfolio actions remain governed separately by 存股作戰地圖 fundamental/valuation/macro gates.
